text:
ok. now, when it comes to this interface. I would like for you to give me a place to write down notes, that will save, and can be things like game features that need t o be made to make the mission possible, for example. 

now, for missions, and for questlines as a whole, i need you to setup for a system now that will let us say 'this is a transitional world state'; meaning, so lets say i have 5 missions. and on mission 3 complete, i want the player to now have their apartment building catch on fire. well so i want to use these points after the fact to be able to come back and author the state changes from a timeline if this makes sense. 

so 

author the world first -> write the questlines -> set parts in the story that change the world -> will be able to then write updates to the map that persist forward from the point
resolution: World-transition infra + persistence. Added WorldTransition/WorldChange types anchored at mission (accept/event/complete) and line (start/complete) story points, with a store seam (add/remove/edit transitions and changes) the deferred timeline editor will drive. The whole storyline board now persists to the twig file (sessions/_route-twigs.json) via readRouteTwigState/writeRouteTwigState — the same door materials uses — so notes and everything else survive reload, closing the 'notes that save' requirement. Files: notes.ts (new shared impl), store.ts, panel.ts.
